record.title: Papua New Guinea Indonesia Wutung Skouw COVID closure
record.region: East and Southeast Asia and Oceania
record.direction: Initial PNG gate closure blocked travel and trade, including entry by returning PNG citizens; endpoint is partial restored bilateral operation.
record.exceptions: Initial PNG order expressly excepted World Health Organization and International Committee of the Red Cross officials. Later authorized exceptions are not fully reconstructed.
record.imposing_authority: PNG immigration minister and West Sepik governor; later bilateral border authorities
record.enforcement: PNG customs and Indonesian border authority confirm resumed operations; locals report informal trade during closure.
record.relationship: Separate from R3-EA-002 September–October 2019 security restrictions.
record.status_observation: Historical evidence; present status not inferred
record.context: January 2020 Wutung closure was followed by a reported lifting by 11 February 2020; subsequent pandemic restrictions and the 24 October 2022 reopening require separate phase reconstruction.
record.uncertainty: January 29 onset refers to PNG Wutung gate. Skouw’s Indonesian side opened May 2022 before Wutung October 24; authorized and informal movements are not fully reconstructed. Existing PNG endpoint evidence specifies PNG nationals. A substantial indexed 12 February 2020 National report quotes the immigration minister saying Wutung had reopened after screening teams were installed. This interrupts any assumed continuous January 2020–October 2022 spell; exact first reopening and later reclosure dates are unresolved.

historical.duration_note: Not eligible for a single continuous-duration calculation; see movement scope, phases and uncertainty. Phased bilateral regime and exceptions; do not calculate one total closure interval.

claim_checks.Historical note — current findings are i: Substantial indexed contemporary reports quoting officials and stranded people establish the Wutung closure. An opened Indonesian retrospective supports the later 2022 resumption.
The February 3 report says the gate shut the previous Wednesday, January 29.
October 24 reopening is supported for the later phase; it cannot be connected continuously to January 2020.

Hierarchical coding: see Rationale coding for subcategories, attribution and phases. The recorded rationale and claim assessment support the selected subcategories. All applicable broad categories are retained together; no primary rationale is imposed. Prior evidence assessment (before this recoding): COVID prevention is explicit.
Initial WHO and ICRC exceptions, citizen returns and later eligibility varied.
A February 12 report quotes the minister saying the gate had reopened by February 11. This contradicts a single uninterrupted 2020–2022 spell; preserve a phased regime and no exact interval.
